text:
Nora: Quick office poll: wefound a tiny rubber duck in conference room B. Name it? Drop one-word suggestions + a one-liner about why.

Sam: Quackster. "Might run meetings in squeaky tones."

Ivy: Admiral. "Promotes high-seas levels of focus."

Raj: Custard. "Sweet, slightly suspicious, supports snacks."

Nora: Ooh love these. tiny rule: one-liners must be 5 words or fewer.

Sam: Bonus: gif replies only if you actually bring a rubber duck.

Ivy: Also: who left leftover lasagna in fridge? guilty parties come forward.

Raj: not me. but I unionize with anyone who labels food.

snackbot: :duck: Duck naming poll started. Options: Quackster, Admiral, Custard. Voting closes in 2 hours.

Nora: quick one-liner contest while we wait: best tension-breaker line for a meeting opener. go.

Sam: "Two truths, one coffee." (works every time)

Ivy: "Is the duck taking notes?"

Raj: "Mic check: sarcasm level?"

snackbot: :trophy: Crowd favorite: "Is the duck taking notes?"

Nora: ok Duck custody logistics: it lives in supply cabinet 3, second shelf. Do not microwave.

Sam: rule: anyone who borrows it must return with a one-liner taped to the beak.

Ivy: pact accepted. one-liners forever. :sparkles:

Raj: closing with a haiku (because why not):
Nora: "Tiny duck on shelf / meeting morale rises slow / jam remains unclaimed"

Nora: thread closed. winner announced in 2 hours. duck emoji rewards imminent.
